stealth-detection.source: The shipped DoorPickLock calls BreakExclusiveAbility only after the loaded ability and tool guards. Its paired client rule has no Sneak admission predicate.
stealth-detection.runtime: An admitted ordinary interaction ends the active Sneak using the normal exclusive state and presentation path. An unloaded or tool refusal preserves Sneak.
stealth-detection.test: SpyObjectStealthMode replays both unloaded and admitted paths at verified stands. Native recorded OBJECT-USE followed by 1111 off and the expected text. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1111#issuecomment-7142948057

behavior-tests.source: The shipped DoorPickLock requires the correct loaded utility and ordinary tool. The locked cabinet immediately unlocks on success.
behavior-tests.runtime: The ordinary radial request runs the resource checks and updates the tracked object's state following the authored rule outcome.
behavior-tests.test: UtilityAbilityTests and StarterSpyUtilitiesTests check the input/tool guards and authored object results.
